name: P☆A Kaichou wa Suki Desu ka? ~Gouman Celeb Tsuma e no Sex Shidou~
original_name: P☆A会長は好きですか?～傲慢セレブ妻へのセックス指導～
source: P☆A Chairman Katsuragi Sayoko is a monster parent who dotes on her only son. One day, she stormed into the school, claiming her son had been subjected to corporal punishment. From that day on, the curtain rises on sexual guidance to discipline the arrogant monster parent!
translation: P☆A会长葛城沙代子是一位溺爱独生子的蛮横家长。一天，她闯进学校，声称儿子遭到体罚。从那天起，为了教训这位傲慢家长而展开的性指导，就此拉开帷幕！
